_note: TEST-ONLY. unified_calendar: firelens.unified_calendar.build() (continuity chain) on the real FIRMS yearly archives for 45N 10E (25 km). current_conditions: same code with a FAKE near-real-time client returning one detection (no MAP_KEY is used for fixtures).

unified_calendar.label: FireHarmonics continuity chain (Aqua MODIS <- S-NPP VIIRS <- NOAA-20 VIIRS), experimental
unified_calendar.unit: active 1-km cell-overpasses on the Aqua-MODIS scale
unified_calendar.unit_definition: A 1-km grid cell (0.01 deg) with at least one quality-controlled vegetation-fire detection in a day or night overpass counts once, however many pixels the sensor split the fire into.
unified_calendar.calibrated_sensor: S-NPP VIIRS (375 m), then NOAA-20 VIIRS (375 m)

validation.method: Held out in time: coefficients fitted on early overlap years (regional priors from the same years only) predict the reference sensor in later years from the newer sensor alone

aqua_snpp.explanation: Fewer than 10 reference units in the test years: errors would be meaningless.

seam_2012.explanation: 1.0 means no artificial step where the calendar switches from Aqua to S-NPP.

limitations: Detections are satellite observations, not fires; the calendar is satellite-observed burning activity on one consistent scale, not the number of fires or burned area.
FIRMS hotspot files contain no clear-sky non-fire observations, so the activity is not normalised for clouds or observation effort; fires hidden by clouds or smoke are not reconstructed.
One coefficient per link and day/night stratum, assumed stable in time; validated forward in time where the overlap allows (see validation), not beyond it.
Low-confidence detections and non-vegetation (static/industrial) sources are excluded.
Years from the FIRMS yearly archives are treated as fully observed; FIRMS-listed missing days are not removed.

season.definition: Onset = month when 10 % of a fire-year's activity is reached, end = 90 %, peak = busiest month; the fire-year starts at the calendar month with the least activity.

current_conditions.reference: S-NPP VIIRS, same calendar window, 2012 onwards
limitations: NOAA-20 is put on the S-NPP scale with the bridge coefficient of the continuity chain.
Near-real-time data may still change; the most recent day can be incomplete.
A value above the past range is unusual for this place, not a forecast of danger.
current_conditions.explanation: 0.9 S-NPP-equivalent active cells (1 NOAA-20 detection) in the last 14 days vs a median of 0 in the same window of 14 past years.
